Okay more seriously PLEASE send some love David Guthrie's way for making such a gorgeous arrangement and mix! This song has that complex combination of dense layers balanced against understated simplicity that he executed to absolute perfection 🤌 Thank you for bringing this to life together with me!!! And for pumping my ego to the max talking about how my translyrics made you cry. Very cheesed!!!!

entry.title: 「lulu.」Mrs. GREEN APPLE - Frieren Season 2 OP (English cover + Cosplay MV)

media:group.media:title: 「lulu.」Mrs. GREEN APPLE - Frieren Season 2 OP (English cover + Cosplay MV)
media:group.media:description:
"If I could be the kindest version left of me What will I change in the world I leave behind?"
We also made an English cover of the ED, The Story of Us! https://youtu.be/w37GTV_3fQ0
📚 Credits 📚 Original by @MrsGREENAPPLE_Official https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MjeiIal1ZR0
Vocals, lyrics, time/tune, video: ‪@ying_verse Arrangement, mix, master: @Legendav Frieren: https://www.instagram.com/meganakamomo Special thanks to my roomie Natsu for shoot day shenanigans :D it was very fun dragging you both around with me on a four hour Monterey speedrun heehee
📚 Streaming 📚 Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/7oCOJHJdvzyHdBrVU6czNS?si=d71ea8be5a304c34 YouTube Music https://youtu.be/bodWRT9I_0k?si=aRF8Y7AyQ8EgUXse Apple Music coming soon!
📚 Lyrics 📚 (Feel free to use for noncommercial and non-AI works with credit!) https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jvuMs6SXeYhUj8a_MVBDJDF9hafOJ49kw2P1a5OPWW8/edit?usp=sharing
So when we come to the end, What’s there left to say? No matter what’s coming next, Don’t let me feel the pain. Those words you told me long ago, and to this day Inside this lingering ache I feel a warmth That never fades
If I could’ve only known, that’s all I need Somewhere out there’s what I haven’t found Don’t worry, I’m not going anywhere There’s nowhere I can go out there, yeah
If someday I find what I’m searching for, Think it might break up something in the flow Let me hide it with a little tune, la-la-la And then continue just the same as old
The memories I still keep Even though I know they’re fading And all of your light in my eyes Shining like gold Always, it’s your image I hold
Soon we’ll find In coming time When the winds of a gently turning tide Slowly unfurls across the world What kind of change will it leave behind? “There’s a place that I can call home” This world is where every one of us was born That promise I made, kept still today, so that its warmth Will never fade
The more that I learn, the more I struggle, although I’ll try sharing the weight of it with you Is that okay? If you’ll still be here? I hope you won’t go anywhere, yeah?
If someday I find what I’m searching for, Feels like something inside might fall apart So I bite my lip and sing a tune, la-la-la The curtains fluttering just like my heart
The memories I still keep Even though I know they’re fading And deep within my heart you’re always there What I’m holding onto Always and forever, is you.
Soon we’ll find In coming time If I could be the kindest version left of me What will I change in the world I leave behind?
The memories from that day of old, I walk with their kindness still embracing my soul Though there are times when we may cry Lost in those moments where we feel alone “There’s a place that I can call home” This world is where every one of us was born And on those very days, the memories we made, You’ll know their warmth Will never fade.
📚 Notes 📚 Guess how many times I cried while working on these lyrics :'D David said he cried while mixing it too so that's two of us down for the count LOL maybe you should consider crying, too. For three days and three nights.
We crunched this one out hella fast out of sheer excitement but I think our labor of love shines through!!!! S2 has been every bit the quiet respite I needed amidst the accelerating chaos of the world right now, and I hope this project brings you all a little warmth and joy as well.
